code.originalText: Six-month post-cystectomy follow-up: kidney function, acid-base, upper-tract ultrasound, and review after a kidney infection

text.paragraph: Six-month follow-up after cystectomy; review after a kidney infection. [S]

Mr. Humphrey returns two months after his last visit, six months after his operation and three weeks after the sick visit for a right kidney infection. The culture grew Escherichia coli susceptible to ciprofloxacin; his fever settled within 48 hours, and he finished the 7-day course. The creatinine recheck planned for one week after that visit was not done, because he was travelling for work. He now drinks about 2 liters a day. Since the new convex wafer he has had no leaks, and the skin below the stoma has healed. Over the past month he has felt more tired by late afternoon, without breathlessness, and his appetite is good. He had a renal ultrasound this morning. He walks 30 minutes most days. [S]
